svg.text: What the machines did, state by state
CPU = busy cores of 16 · disk = share of time busy · IO wait = share of time waiting on IO · mem = p95 anonymous memory, % of cap
Memory excludes the ten minutes around each OOM kill. Dots: no such state for that node. erigon's first column is its single-tree week before the binary
domain. 'binary only' runs from one hour after the fork to the chain's end; the geths were then on 64 GiB caps. nethermind-1's and besu-1's 'migrating'
merge their import (10-23) and their self-conversion under the load (10-27).
